claims.explanation: Crizotinib's selectivity is best explained by dependence on the drug's primary targets, ALK and MET, rather than by any single lineage or common driver mutation. Lines with MET amplification/mutation or ALK/ROS1 activation are sensitized, while lines lacking these dependencies are unaffected; the transcriptional similarity to the ALK inhibitor NVP-TAE684 supports an on-target ALK/MET mechanism.

BRAF mutation activates MAPK signaling and is enriched in killed lines
KRAS mutation activates MAPK signaling and is enriched in killed lines
PIK3CA mutation activates PI3K signaling and is enriched in killed lines
EGFR-mutant lines appear in the least-affected group, suggesting alternative RTK dependence
VHL-mutant 786O is among the least affected lines
NRAS-mutant melanoma lines are among the least affected
CDKN2A loss appears in several least-affected lines
